newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner opens Kleinwort branch in Korea.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner opens Kleinwort branch in Korea.

text.p: Germany's Dresdner Bank AG on Thursday announced the official opening of a Korean branch of its Kleinwort Benson Limited investment banking unit.

Board member Gerd Haeusler, responsible for Asia-Pacific business at Germany's second-largest commercial bank, said in a statement that the opening of the Seoul-based branch showed Dresdner's confidence in the potential of the Korean market.
Dresdner itself has had a representative office in the city since 1984.
Dresdner added that the Asia-Pacific area had been a key region for the bank for some time. It now had 63 bases there in 14 countries, covering commercial and investment banking.
